programme.how_found: Direct URL to METU's official academic catalog (catalog.metu.edu.tr, Faculty of Engineering > DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER ENGINEERING, program id 571); confirmed via ceng.metu.edu.tr -> Undergraduate -> General Information. programme.notes: METU offers a BSc in Computer Engineering, not a programme titled 'Computer Science'; this is the computer-science degree. The catalog lists Northern Cyprus Campus programmes separately as '[NCC] NCC Engineering Programs', so program 571 is the Ankara campus programme.

english.how_found: oidb.metu.edu.tr/en -> English Proficiency -> 'Equivalence Table for English Language Exams Recognized by METU for Undergraduate and Graduate Students'; also linked from iso.metu.edu.tr/en/english-proficiency ('Exams and the minimum scores accepted by ODTÜ').
english.notes: The quoted explanation cell belongs to the table row whose cells read, in order: METU EPE 60 | TOEFL IBT 75 | PTE ACADEMIC 55 (exam taken before 12.11.2024) | PTE ACADEMIC 65 (taken after 12.11.2024). Page last updated 31/08/2026. Scores valid 2 years; TOEFL iBT evaluated on the 120-point scale; EPE 59.50 rounds to 60. IELTS is NOT accepted: iso.metu.edu.tr/en/english-proficiency: 'According to the University Senate Decision, dated December 23, 2022, decision no. 6., IELTS exams taken on or after the 24th of December 2022 will not be anymore accepted.' Also: 'for undergraduate programs, submitting an English proficiency score is not obligatory for the application.' Admitted students without a valid score take the METU EPE; below the minimum they attend a one-year English Preparatory Class.

value.description: METU publishes a list of minimum application requirements per exam/qualification (PDF 'METU ANKARA CAMPUS UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMS - INTERNATIONAL STUDENT MINIMUM APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS', last update 05/01/2024). For Kazakhstan the national route is the Unified National Testing (UNT): minimum 125 out of 140. International routes usable by any applicant: SAT I total 1200 with Math 700/800 for the Faculty of Engineering; ACT 27/36; IB Diploma 33; International A Levels ABB; AP grade 4 in four subjects (incl. Calculus AB/BC for Engineering); TR-YÖS top 5th percentile; international science olympiad medal.
value.exam: Kazakhstan Unified National Testing (UNT), 5 subjects incl. 2 optional subjects related to the programme

alternatives.ap_min: grade 4 in at least four subjects

gpa.quote: Kazakhstan A minimum total score of 125 out of 140 in the Unified National Testing (UNT) in 5 subjects, including 2 optional subjects, related to the program applied for.
gpa.how_found: iso.metu.edu.tr/en -> Undergraduate Applications -> Application Requirements -> link 'available via this link' (odtu_iso_requirements.pdf); also linked from 'Who can Apply?'.
gpa.notes: Second verbatim row from the same PDF: 'SAT I A minimum totalscore of 1200 (with an additional minimum "Math" score of 700 out of 800 for the Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Architecture, and scientific programs offered by the Faculty of Arts and Sciences )'. Kazakhstan is a Category-A country, so the diploma-average-only routes of Category B (80%) / C (90%) do not apply ('Countries listed in Category A will not be covered in Category C, Other Countries.'). An NIS grade-12 diploma on its own therefore does not meet a listed minimum; the applicant needs UNT 125/140 or one of the international exams (e.g. SAT 1200 with Math 700). The PDF states: 'The criteria specified in this document represent the minimum application requirements. However, fulfilling these requirements does not guarantee admission.' Exam results such as TR-YÖS and SAT are valid for two years (application-requirements page). No overall GPA/diploma-average threshold is published for Kazakhstan.

tuition.how_found: iso.metu.edu.tr/en -> Useful Information -> Tuition Fee -> link 'Please click here for the tuition fees for international students' (PDF); same PDF linked from oidb.metu.edu.tr/index.php/en/tuition-fee-amounts ('Please click here for the tuition fees for undergraduate students who registered through international student quotas.').
tuition.notes: PDF heading: '2026-2027 Academic Year Tuition Fees for International Students per semester (those who registered through international student quotas) (ODTÜ/METU Ankara and Erdemli Campuses)'. The 1200 USD column applies to 'For those who start their program in the 2023-2024 Fall semester or later (per semester)', i.e. to a 2027 entrant; the 34055 TL columns are for earlier cohorts. 2027/28 fees not yet published (PDF dated 14/09/2026). Fee is for semesters within the normal duration plus two further semesters; afterwards 1.5x applies. USD amounts are converted to Turkish lira at the CBRT selling rate one week before each payment period and paid in TL; a minimum from the Official Gazette applies if the conversion is lower. English Preparatory Year students pay the same fee as their faculty's undergraduate programme. The separate TL table (17027 TL for Engineering) is only for foreign nationals who completed secondary school in Türkiye and entered via YKS central placement, so it does not apply here.

value.name: Tuition Fee Discount / Exemption for international undergraduate students (METU Senate 'Implementation Principles Regarding Ankara Campus Tuition Discounts or Exemptions for International Undergraduate Students', Senate Decision 26 April 2022)

scholarship_exists.quote: For the students who are newly admitted to their programs, documents such as exams and diplomas submitted during the application are taken into consideration in the evaluation for tuition fee discounts/exemptions.
scholarship_exists.how_found: iso.metu.edu.tr/en -> Useful Information -> Scholarship Opportunities (section 'Tuition Fee Discount / Exemption') -> link 'here for the undergraduate students' -> oidb implementation-principles page.
scholarship_exists.notes: University-run tuition waiver, not an externally funded scholarship. Definitions on the page: 'A tuition fee discount refers to an exemption from the fifty percent of the tuition fee of the relevant semester, whereas a tuition fee exemption refers to a full exemption from the tuition fee of the relevant semester.' Capacity: 'Ten percent of the total number of international students (those students who registered through international students quotas) registered in undergraduate programs can receive a tuition discount or exemption'. Criterion is academic success; newly admitted students are evaluated on the exams/diplomas submitted in the application, so an incoming applicant is considered automatically. No application needed (iso page: 'In order to benefit from discounts or exemptions, you do not need to make an application.'). Valid one academic year; continuation requires CGPA 3.00 (discount) / 3.50 (exemption). METU also lists need-based meal and dormitory scholarships and METU Development Foundation cash aid for enrolled international students (in-person application at the Scholarship and Tuition Fee Office, Sept-Oct / Feb-Mar) - these are for registered students, not incoming applicants.

scholarship_international.quote: Ten percent of the total number of international students (those students who registered through international students quotas) registered in undergraduate programs can receive a tuition discount or exemption within the scope of these implementation principles.
scholarship_international.how_found: Same page as scholarship_exists (title: 'Middle East Technical University Implementation Principles Regarding Ankara Campus Tuition Discounts or Exemptions for International Undergraduate Students').
scholarship_international.notes: The scheme is exclusively for international students admitted through the international student quotas; the iso page states 'Our University provides tuition discounts or exemptions for international students according to their academic success.' Excluded: students whose fees are paid by other institutions and students in international joint degree programmes (SUNY programmes).
